run_fastRNN_training: run the fastRNN training loop for minGRU, minLSTM, or hawk models via CLI config
build_train_args: build a TrainArgs dataclass to configure training hyperparameters, data, optimizer, and distributed settings
create_train_state: create a TrainState object to track optimizer steps, accumulation steps, scheduler, and dataloader state
validate_train_args: validate TrainArgs to check vocab size, data paths, distributed parallelism, and checkpoint configuration
parallelize_and_train_model: parallelize an LMMinGRU, LMMinLSTM, or LMHawk model across GPUs and run the full training loop
